visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a dessert in a white ceramic cup adorned with a blue wave pattern. A hand lifts a blue lid to reveal a pudding topped with orange slices, red beans, and a dollop of cream. (2) Transition to a promotional poster displayed on a sushi conveyor belt, showing the same dessert with text in Chinese. Then, the camera shows two dessert cups on a red plastic plate on a pink table. (3) A man with long, dark, wavy hair, wearing a denim shirt over a white t-shirt and multiple necklaces, stands in a brightly lit sushi restaurant. He speaks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with his hands. (4) The camera pans to a group of four women sitting at a booth table in the restaurant. They look toward the man. (5) Shots of the dessert cups moving along a conveyor belt are shown. The women are then seen clapping and reacting with excitement. (6) Several shots follow showing the women tasting the dessert using small wooden spoons. They exhibit exaggerated facial expressions of enjoyment. (7) Close-ups of the dessert being scooped are interspersed with shots of the women talking and laughing. (8) The man is seen interviewing a male customer with glasses in another booth. They are both smiling. (9) The women hold up empty ceramic cups to the camera, indicating they have finished the dessert. (10) The focus shifts to various plates of salmon sushi on a conveyor belt and being held with chopsticks. (11) The final screen features the main man and two other men in a stylized graphic with the product name and price information.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo electronic pop music begins immediately with a bright synth lead and a steady kick drum. A male voice speaks rapidly and energetically in Chinese. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect plays. The BGM continues as the male voice continues his upbeat narration. (3) Sound of multiple female voices laughing and cheering overlaps with the music. (4) The male narrator's voice is joined by female voices giving brief, enthusiastic reactions. (5) Ambient restaurant sounds like light plate clinking are audible in the background but mixed low. (6) A comedic 'pop' sound effect occurs. (7) The male voice interviews another person; the interviewee's voice is slightly more distant but clear. (8) The music builds in volume during a final product showcase with more laughter tracks layered in.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Demonstration -> Tasting/Testimonial -> Alternative Pairing -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To announce and promote a co-branded limited-edition dessert, 'Roasted Tea Pudding,' available at Sushiro restaurants. The video uses a highly energetic vlog style with 'judges' and customer testimonials to build hype and social proof.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the brand Sushiro and focuses entirely on a specific new product launched in collaboration with the creator.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing techniques, including high-contrast colors, fast-paced jump cuts, and variety-show style text overlays to maintain viewer engagement and create a fun, youthful brand image.
